messages:
maria: Heads-up — CloudPartner is testing two reporting modes: hourly sampled batches and near-real-time event stream. They want guidance on which to prioritize for our marketplace billing flow.

sam: What's causing the split? bandwidth? partner infra?

maria: They have limited on-device bandwidth, so devices do hourly rollups. But the SI can also open a websocket for live events from gateways. Both have different idempotency/dedupe needs.

jordan: For billing correctness, hourly granularity increases reconciliation complexity (late arrivals, timezone skew). Real-time helps entitlements but increases QPS.

alex: Quick note: our current ingestion pipeline expects per-minute granularity. Hourly rollups will need schema change: include sample_count, min_ts, max_ts, and a stable namespace id.

maria: Can we accept both? Idea: accept real-time as primary and hourly as fallback with a "rollup_hint" flag + provenance header.

sunita: +1. Need a clear SLA table. If hourly fallback arrives later than realtime, how do we avoid double-charging?

ops-bot: deploy-notify: ingestion-edge v3.4 rolled out to staging at 11:12

sam: Proposed heuristic: event stream wins for timestamps <= now-5m. Hourly rollups only backfill missing windows older than 10m and marked as backfill=true.

jordan: Also include a fingerprint: sha256(partner_id + device_id + window_start + metric) so dedupe is deterministic.

alex: snippet for webhook ack we can give them:

``
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Content-Type: application/json
{"status": "accepted", "ingest_id": "<uuid>", "dedupe_key": "<fingerprint>"}
``

maria: action items:
- maria: write partner contract wording for rollup_hint/backfill (due Tue)
- alex: update ingestion schema & validate sample_count semantics (due Wed)
- sam: add SLA table to partner portal + billing edgecases doc (due Thu)
- jordan: implement fingerprinting + dedupe in staging (due Thu)

sunita: I'll schedule a 30m sync with CloudPartner + SI tomorrow 10am PT. Add agenda: SLA, dedupe keys, backfill policy, test vectors.

maria: Thanks all — ping me if you want to join the sync. I'll upload test payload examples to the drive after lunch :drive:

sam: ack

jordan: ack

alex: ack

ops-bot: reminder: runback-reconciler job runs daily at 03:00 UTC
